fields: L5 Shanghai / Dragon Boat Festival (e-bike; Lujiazui → the Bund → Huaihai Road → Xintiandi). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 端午摊 Zongzi Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Xintiandi-entrance final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Xintiandi final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 端午谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L4 banks (all grades).

questions.subject: shanghai
questions.q_en: From the Bund, Flora looks across the Huangpu and sees the sphere-shaped tower in Lujiazui. What landmark is it?
questions.q_zh: Flora 站在外滩，隔着黄浦江看见陆家嘴那座有圆球体的高塔。那是哪座地标？
questions.explain_en: The sphere-shaped tower in Lujiazui is the Oriental Pearl.
questions.explain_zh: 陆家嘴那座有圆球体的塔是东方明珠。
questions.qtype_zh: 上海地标（陆家嘴/外滩/新天地）

questions.subject: safety
questions.q_en: On Huaihai Road under the plane trees, the light turns red as Flora rides her e-bike. What should she do?
questions.q_zh: 淮海路梧桐树下，Flora 骑着电动车时灯变红了。她应该怎么做？
choices: Ride on the sidewalk at full speed
Race through as fast as she can
Close her eyes and keep going
questions.explain_en: A red light means stop, even on an e-bike.
questions.explain_zh: 红灯要停，骑电动车也一样。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A gift box of zongzi at Xintiandi is 40 cm × 15 cm × 22 cm. What is its volume in cm³?
questions.q_zh: 新天地一个粽子礼盒长 40 厘米、宽 15 厘米、高 22 厘米，体积是多少立方厘米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Flora rides 1/3 km along the Bund and then 9/10 km to Xintiandi. How many km does she ride? (simplest form)
questions.q_zh: Flora 沿外滩骑了 1/3 千米，又骑了 9/10 千米到新天地，一共骑了多少千米？（最简分数）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: 40 visitors stand by the Bund at sunset, and 45% of them watch a dragon boat. How many watch a dragon boat?
questions.q_zh: 傍晚外滩有 40 位游客，其中 45% 在看龙舟，有多少人在看龙舟？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Over four evenings, Flora counts 12, 15, 19 and 14 boats passing the Bund. What is the mean number per evening?
questions.q_zh: 连续四个晚上，Flora 在外滩数到 12、15、19、14 条船，平均每晚几条？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A welcome mat at the Xintiandi door is 14 m long and 7 m wide. What area does it cover in square metres?
questions.q_zh: 新天地门口的迎宾地毯长 14 米、宽 7 米，面积是多少平方米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On the Bund, 53 green flags and 38 gold flags fly for the boat race. How many more green flags than gold ones are there?
questions.q_zh: 外滩为龙舟赛挂了 53 面绿旗和 38 面金旗，绿旗比金旗多几面？
questions.qtype_zh: 比较相差（多多少/高多少）
